scope: Materialized r2 overlay plus three mathematical holdout guides; original 58 entries unchanged. Required by unchanged single-overlay loader. No existing file reclassification, relocation or quota change.

Root LICENSE.txt is recorded explicitly as inherited coverage. Two attributed Guide to NumPy adaptations rejected.

split_policy: Existing source units unchanged. CPython email/urllib docs follow existing validation/test units. Dedup clusters crossing roles must be excluded, not moved.
